SCP 5192 consists of SCP 5192-1 and SCP 5192-2. SCP 5192-1
appear to be multiple cows with carnivorous nutrition. Their appearance consists of a thick layer of crimson fur and long pairs of horns. The subjects appear to be extremely hostile to every form of life. Their height is approximately 1.92m while their width is approximately 1.5 meters. Among instances of SCP 5192-1 stands out SCP 5192-A which is known as "The mother".

Deleted an article by GamerboyAli at -3 with zero staff votes, improper-self delete summary deletion.

Description: SCP-5133 appears to be a female of African descent in her early twenties, 150 cm1 tall and 41kg2, with black hair and brown eyes. Anyone that views SCP-5133's face will instinctively think that it is their mother. This anomalous effect will lead the subject to follow every command that is given by SCP-5133. This can include considerably dangerous acts. However, if the subject is deaf, the command that is given will not work3.

No feedback present. Nagiros witnessed.

Footnotes
1. Approximately 4'11".
2. Approximately 90 lbs.
3. However, SCP-5133 will be able to use sign language to communicate with the subject.

item.content:encoded:
SCP-5138 appears as a small grove of Japanese White Birch (Betula Platyphylla) in [REDACTED], Scotland. The anomaly always appears in autumnal colours and sheds a seemingly infinite amount of otherwise non-anomalous leaves. Walking down the grove will lead to a bamboo archway, which, when entered transports individuals to a traditional Japanese garden, hereby referred to as SCP-5138-1. The garden has been reported to evoke feelings of peace in all cases.

Deleted at -22 and three votes. Rewrite by Ayumi-san is pending.

SCP-5358 is a human male about twenty-four (24) years in age, and standing about 1.8 meters in height. Medical checkups so far have found no physical anomalies on the internal and external body of SCP-5358. IQ tests have given it a slightly above-average intelligence level of 116.

Deleted at -18 and three votes.

Feedback Ported:

Unihedron

+ show block
– hide block

I'm sorry to say, but this feels really incomplete. Whatever intrigue that the article brings me remains unanswered throughout to the end and quite honestly this feels like it's written by someone who doesn't understand or bothered attempting to elaborate on why being able to hack into outright anything is anomalous, or even interesting. The name drop to UIU had a reverse impact on me; instead of making me feel "wow, they could do that?" it made me go "there's no way this makes sense".

I think this suffers a case of show-don't-tell in that I'm being told how outrageous the situation is but nothing that pulls its weight and make it feel grand, rather that it's odd being delivered this way. I think the places in the article like the breach and the high cooperation level as shown could be translated into logs that are interesting to read and experience, but in its current form it really feels lacking.

FluffyDog00

+ show block
– hide block

In order for an article to work, there needs to be a strong narrative with a clear beginning, middle, and end. This has a beginning and a middle. There are no stakes, just a dude who is really good at something, and has no further character development other than that. It's boring and tasteless.

-1

SCP-5127 is an anomalous object that resembles a wax figure of an unknown origin. SCP-5127 seems to be completely inanimate until it is approached by any living subject in 5 meters. If a living being enters the 5 meters seclusion zone SCP-5127 will become semi-conscious and will not return to its inanimate state until it has neutralized the subject. Attempts to interview SCP-5127 during its semi-conscious state but these attempts failed. All testing has been suspended.

Deletion at -22 and three votes.

item.content:encoded:
SCP-5368-A is an entity that infused itself with Tiger tank 132, designated as SCP-5368-B. SCP-5368-A can utilize all of SCP-5368-B's system, including its 88 mm cannon and 2× 7.92 mm MG34. SCP-5368-A also apparently has some unique abilities and characteristics as the weapons and armor on SCP-5368-B seems to be enhanced, allowing better protection and firepower. SCP-5368 is remarkably aggressive and territorial. All non-personnel must not come in contact with it. If aggravated, SCP-5368 will become hostile and attempt to destroy anything in its vicinity. All SCP Foundation personnel guarding SCP-5368 must immediately respond and engage until SCP-5368 reverts back to its passive mode, which averagely lasts from 30 minutes to 2 hours. Air support is necessary as it will presumably bring the time of aggravation down by half an hour, but still remains harmless to SCP-5368. Any non-personnel who come into contact with SCP-5368 must be given amnestics and misinformed by MTF Gamma-5.

Deleted at -16 and three votes.

item.title: Deletions 70: If the fact will not fit the theory – let the theory go.: Re: Deletions 70: If the fact will not fit the theory – let the theory go.
item.content:encoded:
/scp-5492 (no title) by CocoaIzBlu deleted at -20 and three votes.

SCP-5492 is a speaker-like object produced somewhere in the 1800s, probably tracing back to 1877. Object#: 5492 is a half-rotten spruce cuboid, plated with metal speakers made with aluminium. Its main colour is white due to the clear lack of pigmentation in SCP-5492's shape, making the wood hard to classify to the eye.

Feedback ported:

[+] from DoctorSasbo
– hide block

It's really unfortunate that everybody is downvoting this without actually commenting suggestions to help it. Here's my two cents:

The biggest issue with this imo is the prose:

  • "immensely scant amount of room, and heaps of soundproof foam" is not clinical enough for an official document. Try saying "an enclosed space insulated by soundproof foam", or state the measurements if you want to drive home the extent of it
  • "due to the lack of knowledge on SCP-5492" - If it's being researched, we already know there's a lack of knowledge, so the phrase is redundant
  • "somewhere in the 1800s, probably tracing back to 1877" - Firstly, I think you meant "sometime" instead of "somewhere." Secondly, if you have that specific of a year, it doesn't make sense to add uncertainty by saying "probably." Finally, you might want to briefly say where it's from/was found.
  • "Its main colour is white due to the clear lack of pigmentation in SCP-5492's shape, making the wood hard to classify to the eye" could just be "It is predominantly white." You're spending a lot of words elaborating on something that could be written more concisely.
  • "at the first glances… teeth to commit suicide." is too long of a sentence, try breaking it up into multiple sentences so the reader can more effectively process it
  • ""the noise is so dreadful it's better to die than live to remember the horror" - Which was said by a test subject." I get what you're going for, but it comes off as kinda flat and cliche. You might want to flesh it out a bit more with an interview log, so you can go more in detail about the effects on the subject.
  • "the unfathomable entity" doesn't fit the clinical tone. It's SCP-5492.
  • "When the surviving Subject made it out of the containment he was insane and instead of being suicidal he was critically homicidal instead." Instead of just saying he's homicidal, try describing what he did i.e. stab researchers, torture fellow D-class, etc.

Overall, I think this is a workable concept, but the execution is severely lacking. Tighten up your prose, and try to elaborate more on what actually happens so you can show instead of just telling. Hope this helps!
